paras: When it comes to elevating your vehicle’s handling, precision, and on-track performance, AST delivers uncompromising quality engineered for the most demanding drivers. Whether you are carving up local backroads or chasing podiums at Time Attack events, AST provides a suspension solution tailored to your exact needs.

All AST series feature a high-pressure inverted monotube design (for McPherson applications), height adjustability, included springs, and fully rebuildable architecture. The primary differences lie in their adjustability, remote reservoir inclusion, and topmount configurations.
